description: This file defines the main UI component and navigation for an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It sets up themes, navigation, MQTT message handling, and UI composition including top and bottom bars with navigation tabs. It also manages state for radar data points and configuration parameters, and interacts with MQTT broker to send commands.

classes.name: BottomTab
classes.description: Enum representing the bottom navigation tabs: Dashboard, Plot2D, Plot3D.

methods.name: AppRoot
methods.description: Main composable function that initializes the app theme, navigation, MQTT client, and manages main UI scaffold including top bar, bottom bar, and content.

methods.name: AppContent
methods.description: Sets up MQTT message collection, state management, and Scaffold layout with top and bottom bars. Manages user interactions and MQTT messaging for device control.

methods.name: AppNavHost
methods.description: Configures navigation graph for the app's main screens: dashboard, 2D plot, and 3D plot.

methods.name: samplePoints2D
methods.description: Generates sample 2D radar points for initial display.

methods.name: samplePoints3D
methods.description: Generates sample 3D radar points for initial display.
